testo:
■ Your evolution creatures cost 1 less to summon. They can't cost 0 or less.
■ When you put this creature, it can't leave until the start of your next turn.
■ Shinkapower: When this creature evolves, your opponent can't cast spells that cost 4 or less until the start of your next turn.
